title: Tool invocation safeguard adaptor and localized fault guidance
creator: Marcus Li
description: Problem: Tool/function call workflows are brittle when callers supply permissive or legacy parameter shapes. Current runtime rejects or returns opaque failures that surface poor UX for SDK customers and increases support load. Goal: implement a runtime "safeguard adaptor" layer that performs graded validation, automated coercions, and localized, actionable error messages while preserving strict contract guarantees for the downstream tool executors.
acceptance_criteria: Safeguard adaptor runs before tool executor and can operate in three modes: permissive, advisory, and strict.

When in permissive or advisory mode the adaptor will attempt well-defined coercions (type casts, ISO8601 date parsing, numeric string -> number, enum fuzzy match) and attach a diagnostics object to requests indicating what was changed.
Errors returned to callers follow new standardized schema: {code, severity, message, field, hint, suggestion_id}. Messages must be localized when SDK sends Accept-Language header.
Telemetry emitted for each validation event: validation_mode, matched_adaptations[], error_code, latency_ms, tool_key, model_variant.
Integration tests covering legacy payloads (v1 shape) to new strict tool schemas with both successful adaptions and deterministic rejection paths.
Runtime feature flag present to toggle adaptor per-customer and per-route; default deployed off for enterprise-signed customers until rollout window completes.
implementation_notes: Introduce a lightweight adaptation pipeline implemented as sequence of pluggable transforms (coerce, normalize, canonicalize) with deterministic prioritization.
Validation leveled into: L0 (coerce quietly), L1 (advisory with diagnostics), L2 (return structured error). Configurable per-route and via policy center.
Store canonicalization rules as simple JSON manifests alongside tool specs. Each rule contains: path (json-pointer), op (coerce|rename|enum-suggest|date-parse), confidence_score.
Provide SDK helpers (ts/py) to convert suggestion_id into clickable dev-hints and inline patch snippets for quick fixes.

Localization layer: translation keys stored in i18n bundle; adaptor returns key + interpolation placeholders when Accept-Language is detected; SDK resolves to human text when offline translations available.
Backward-compat shim: support rule fallback for tools with attribute "legacy_shape": true; ensure telemetry tags legacy=true.
Security: do not allow adaptor to perform arbitrary code execution. All transforms must be declarative and whitelist-supported.
Prefetch: compile adaptation manifests to an optimized trie at startup to keep per-request overhead < 0.5ms median.
error_taxonomy_sample: TOOL.VALIDATION.TYPE_MISMATCH - severity: error - message: "Expected number at /payment/amount but received \"abc\"." - hint: "Try passing a numeric literal or a stringified number (e.g. \"42\")." suggestion_id: suggest.coerce_number

TOOL.VALIDATION.MISSING_REQUIRED - severity: error - message: "Missing required field /user/email." - hint: "Add 'email' in payload or set defaultEmail in tool config." suggestion_id: suggest.add_required_param

TOOL.VALIDATION.ENUM_NEAR_MATCH - severity: warning - message: "Value \"invoce\" at /invoice/type looks like \"invoice\"." - hint: "Adaptor will auto-correct in permissive mode." suggestion_id: suggest.enum_fuzzy

TOOL.VALIDATION.DATE_PARSE_FAIL - severity: error - message: "Unrecognized date format at /event/start_time." - hint: "Accepts ISO8601 or epoch millis. Use 2025-02-21T15:00:00Z." suggestion_id: suggest.date_iso
telemetry_contract: adaptations = list of suggestion_id that were applied
legacy_shape = true/false tag if fallback rules used
test_plan: Unit tests for each transform with edge cases (large numeric strings, nested optional arrays, unicode whitespace).
Property-based tests to ensure deterministic coercion results for equivalent inputs.
Integration tests: end-to-end request through adaptor -> executor asserting diagnostics payload and that executor sees canonicalized shape.
Localization tests: ensure Accept-Language: fr returns fr translation keys resolved by SDK; fallback to en when missing.
Load test: simulate 10k requests/sec with short-circuit for no-op validations to validate <1% tail latency impact.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): deploy adaptor in permissive mode for internal routes only; monitor validation.latency_ms and error.rate over 48h.
Phase 2 (beta): enable advisory mode for 5% of customer traffic with telemetry alerting when per-route advisory rate > 2%.
Phase 3 (opt-in GA): expose adaptor toggle in Console per-route; default remains off; document migration guide and SDK patch helper.
Phase 4 (GA): enable strict mode only where customers have opted in or signed enterprise agreements; provide rollback playbook.
